call_points.text: Price corrections to be fully reflected in Q3FY27.
India grew 28%, North America 37%, Europe 21%, Australia 17%.
Raw material cost rose 5% versus 3-4% expected; cost cuts and in-house motors offset.
About half of Q1 capex went to the MK2 campus shift; land bought in Italy.
Aftermarket parts are 28-30% of India revenue and 15-16% of rest-of-world.
US tariff at 25% is being absorbed; further increases are the main risk.
Net cash position remains very strong.
Demand=Match technology to be embedded across all products globally within a year.
**Competitive response:** Validated low-cost compressor range ready to launch in India in September, followed by global markets next year.
**Q1FY27 outlook:** Top-line growth expected to track similar to last year, with bottom-line margin percentages roughly flat.
**European operations:** Broke even at EBITDA in Q4 and expected to achieve marginal operational profitability in FY27.
**Order conversion delays:** Inquiry levels remain strong in India, but conversion cycles are elongating due to West Asia uncertainties.
**Working capital:** Inventory rationalization completed in core Elgi units and Rotair; focus now shifting to US and Australian distribution networks.

timeline.summary: Jairam Varadaraj, on behalf of Elgi Equipments Limited’s promoter group, declared no new encumbrances on shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
CRISIL reaffirmed Elgi Equipments' CRISIL AA/Stable long-term and CRISIL A1+ short-term ratings on ₹557.4 Cr of bank facilities, with no change from the previous report.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,112.6 Cr (+12.1% YoY), net profit ₹128 Cr.
Elgi Equipments Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹2.70 per equity share for FY2026, with record date July 17, 2026.
Elgi Equipments reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,113 Cr and a net cash position of ₹621 Cr.
Management held Q4FY26 concall, guiding to ~₹200 Cr capex in FY27, Europe turnaround, and June price increases to counter metal inflation.
Elgi's Q1FY27 call (Aug 14, 2026) reported 23% revenue growth with 7% from exchange, EBITDA up 28%, and reiterated the 18% margin target by 2031.
